title: General Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #16 (대각 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Romanian woman, an adult, in her early 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, vivid copper-orange hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with opals in silver-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold a hair ornament. Full body fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 36% of the way down her figure from the top, about 56% of the way down her figure from the top and about 74% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID SILVER undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries solid polished black granite fused directly into her own form, fine natural speckled texture flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface with VIVID silver mineral fleck detail. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
